user.description: Choose a device to set up

abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured Tesla-protocol TPMS sensors found. The sensors only transmit when the wheel is turning; drive the car, or wake a sensor with a TPMS activation tool, then retry.
abort.not_supported: This device does not broadcast a Tesla-protocol TPMS advertisement

init.title: Decoding options
init.description: The pressure and temperature formulas were derived by reverse engineering and are accurate to roughly 1.5%. Use 'default' unless you have measured otherwise; use the trim fields to correct against a reference gauge.

data_description.connect: For sensors that never put a reading in their advertisement. Home Assistant connects to the sensor and asks for pressure and temperature, the way a car does. Needs a connectable adapter or proxy, uses a little sensor battery, and the request format is still being confirmed — leave off unless the advertisement shows no reading.
